description: Repairs r-wire/ado-write-values: the first failed odd-byte FText put left the one shared recordset unusable (112 later calls raised "Update or CancelUpdate without AddNew or Edit"), so rows 811 onward and FMemo, FBin and FOle were never written. On a read-write copy of r-wire-blank (ACE OLE DB), for each r-wire cell of FSingle, FDouble, FCurr and FDate: a fresh server keyset optimistic adCmdTable recordset on W, AddNew, Fields("ID").Value = id, Fields(column).Value = Arg and read back, Update and EditMode, Connection.Errors read and cleared, CancelUpdate and EditMode, Errors read and cleared, Close and State. Then each of these columns is read through a client static read-only recordset (field metadata, GetRows(-1)). Asks per cell the HRESULT and error of the put, Update and CancelUpdate, and the stored tag and exact value or absence. Cells: FByte (IDs from 100): ui1-0, ui1-255, i2-256, i2-minus1, r8-1.5, r8-2.5; FInt (IDs from 200): i2-min, i2-max, i4-32768, i4-minus32769, r8-1.5, r8-2.5; FLong (IDs from 300): i4-min, i4-max, r8-2147483648, r8-minus2147483649, r8-0.5, r8-1.5, r8-2.5; FSingle (IDs from 400): plus-zero, minus-zero, min-subnormal, max-subnormal, min-normal, max-finite, plus-inf, minus-inf, qnan, qnan-payload, snan, negative-qnan, r8-1e39, r8-1e-50, r8-0.1; FDouble (IDs from 500): plus-zero, minus-zero, min-subnormal, max-subnormal, min-normal, max-finite, plus-inf, minus-inf, qnan, qnan-payload, snan, negative-qnan, one-plus-ulp, r4-0.1-widened, r8-0.1; FCurr (IDs from 600): cy-min, cy-max, cy-0.0001, cy-minus-0.0001, r8-0.00005, r8-0.00015, r8-1e15, bstr-5-decimals; FDate (IDs from 700): oa-0, oa-min, oa-max, below-min, above-max, negative-1.5, negative-0.25, positive-1.5, one-millisecond, half-second, nan, plus-inf, r8-tag-1.5, bstr-iso; FText (IDs from 800): empty, ascii, bmp, nul-middle, nul-only, astral, lone-high, lone-low, reversed-pair, u-fffe, odd-1-byte, odd-3-bytes, odd-3-bytes-high, len-255, len-256; FMemo (IDs from 900): empty, nul-middle, lone-high, lone-low, odd-1-byte, odd-5-bytes, len-300, len-5000, astral-4000, odd-8001-bytes; FBin (IDs from 1000): empty, leading-zeros, all-zero, ramp-255, ramp-256, bstr-ab, bstr-odd-3-bytes, hex-literal; FOle (IDs from 1100): empty, leading-zeros, ramp-256, pattern-5000, bstr-ab, bstr-odd-3-bytes

args.text: SELECT ID, FSingle FROM W WHERE ID BETWEEN 400 AND 499 ORDER BY ID
SELECT ID, FDouble FROM W WHERE ID BETWEEN 500 AND 599 ORDER BY ID
SELECT ID, FCurr FROM W WHERE ID BETWEEN 600 AND 699 ORDER BY ID
SELECT ID, FDate FROM W WHERE ID BETWEEN 700 AND 799 ORDER BY ID
